title: TECHNAETHER
description: Aesthetic and refreshed. Focused on exploring The Aether and creating steampunk inspired mechanism
body:
Technaether, is an aesthetic and refreshed version of minecraft. Focused on exploring The Aether and creating steampunk inspired mechanism.

![refined world gen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/be97dfcf6df6bace75932da9b121f5ccd2f7b436.jpeg)![the aether](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d760edd327ca2f7662b21e8ca74521443eab7ec6.jpeg)![create](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b82de1fcaca0ce055651e832d7878cfe020e6fea.jpeg)![new bosses & mobs](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/750a5cec267e803c7bc6a93fa74250e37d43e606.jpeg)![overhauled dimensions](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f0b8c887923994f71aabce078d4a801bb0968f7f.jpeg)

- ✔️ The Aether
- ✔️ 80+ New and reworked biomes
- ✔️ New Bosses and creatures
- ✔️ Create - Mechanical engineering
- ✔️ Overhauled Nether and End
- ✔️ New Structures
- ✔️ Dynamic seasonal cycle - With seasonal crops
- ✔️ Custom cooking system
- ✔️ Improved third person gameplay
 
A few quality of life mods:

- ✔️ LOOTR - Multiplayer loot chests are instanced and visually unique
- ✔️ Veinmeiner & Timber Enchantments
- ✔️ Better Advancements
- ✔️ Death Finder - Death messages with coordinates!
- ✔️ Carry on
- ✔️ Crawl
- ✔️ Nature's Compass

Check changelog for a complete and organized mod list
